name: Thought Atlas / sober pastel
principles: Serif panel titles with quiet sans-serif data labels
Sparse reference rules; no panel boxes
Pastel fills with darker line and marker edges
Numeric annotations, labeled lanes, marker shapes and line patterns retain meaning without hue

accessibility.notes: Simulation is a design check, not a guarantee for every observer. Distinctions also use values, spatial grouping, shapes, and line patterns.

compact_layout.label_policy: Shared axis labels and legends; horizontal wrapped trajectory row labels; full model names retained.
compact_layout.additional_appendix_material: Random-feature control; main content still ends on page 8.

signature_ladder.panel_a: Conversational and cognitive-operation labels separated by group headers, colored rules, circle/square keys and a white divider; source frameworks cited in caption. Shared prevalence scale.
signature_ladder.panel_b: Single connected cumulative ladder from uniform eight-domain prediction through length-only, amount, and timing; one shared gray baseline per model. Open endpoints add amount; filled endpoints add timing.
signature_ladder.uncertainty: Pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals on cumulative gains, jointly resampled at all stages. Original paired tests retained for increments.
signature_ladder.accessibility_review: Original, grayscale, deuteranomaly and tritanomaly severity 100 previews reviewed after redesign.

random_timing_control.placement: Appendix Figure 9, referenced next to the main timing result; avoids overlap of control and amount markers on the cumulative Figure 1 scale.
random_timing_control.scale: Increment in held-out log score beyond length plus amount; zero explicitly separates help from harm.
random_timing_control.encoding: Family-specific blue circles / ochre squares for actual timing; gray crosses for the 100-draw randomized-control means; pointwise 95% intervals; multiplicity-adjusted paired contrasts in text and CSV.
random_timing_control.review: Original, grayscale, deuteranomaly and tritanomaly severity 100; PDF at page size.
